body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Schwinn Bicycles, America's most recognized bicycle brand, today announced that its fast charging electric bike 'Tailwind' during CES 2009.

The Tailwind represents the next generation of eBikes and features the world's fastest charging battery built by Toshiba. Toshiba's SCiB power technology will enable Tailwind owners to recharge their eBike in 30 minutes through a standard electrical outlet.
According to the company, it will be available for purchase beginning later this month at Independent Bicycle Dealers(IBDs) throughout the United States.
